rules: Never award multiple-timeline evidence credit for mere mathematical possibility or simulation.
Distinguish source publication date from retrieval date.
Never fabricate session token usage, elapsed time, experiment conditions, or confidence.
Check cited sources before new evidence classification.
Record a reproducible rationale for any meter change.
Apply PROJECT_RULES.md: plan roughly 75% rigorous research and 25% roadmap-aligned website work over meaningful cycles, without fabricated effort telemetry.

Every worker and GPT chat must refresh the full Session Observatory and transition decision after EVERY substantive work round, even if the scientific verdict does not move; append a verified roundLog record.
Core mission is real history multiplicity in our universe; do not make backward time travel the center of inquiry.
handoff.minimumPacket: Repository authority · session ID · verified change (with source) · unresolved limit · one highest-value next action · restart guardrails
handoff.continuity: Founding session S-001 through R005 remains active. Research Note 004 now defines the central hypothesis; SRC-058..063, NOTE-026..032, WL-008/009 and VC-006 are authoritative. Readable typography overrides in assets/readability.css need cross-device verification. Continue with quantitative observational equivalence. Every round must refresh the entire Observatory.

readinessModel.purpose: Recommend a chat transition without arbitrary time limits or fabricated context measurements.
decisionRules: Continue while reasoning remains coherent and a meaningful deliverable is underway.
Prepare a checkpoint when continuity shows warning signs or a milestone is complete but the restart record lacks essentials.
Recommend handoff when severe continuity degradation is reported and an adequate checkpoint is saved, or when a completed milestone meets a new-phase boundary and a valid checkpoint.
Never use a fabricated token budget, elapsed time, percentage of actual GPT context, or fixed short session duration as a handoff trigger.
readinessModel.telemetry: Self-reported browser signals, not live ChatGPT instrumentation. Browser drafts are not versioned until reviewed and committed.
